name: ABB
old_description: Global manufacturer of switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, and electric motors.
about:
ABB is headquartered in Cary, North Carolina. The company was founded in 1988.

ABB manufactures switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, and electric motors, and provides electrification, automation, robotics, and digital solutions. Its portfolio includes the SACE Emax 3 air circuit breaker, the GoFa collaborative robot with ultra-accuracy, Azipod electric propulsion systems, and the ABB Ability Digital Powertrain for remote asset monitoring. The company operates across electrification, automation, motion, robotics, and power conversion, delivering products ranging from medium-voltage switchgear to industrial IoT and AI suites.

Customers span buildings and construction, data centers, food and beverage, marine shipping, oil and gas, and power generation utilities. ABB notes that one in four data centers worldwide run on its technology, and its solutions are used to decarbonize shipping and optimize energy infrastructure. Its automation business offers industry-specific integrated automation, control technologies, software, and advanced services.

ABB positions itself as a global technology leader in electrification and automation, aiming to help industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable so they can 'outrun' competitors. The company emphasizes connecting engineering and digitalization expertise to accelerate decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.
